Package uno.v1.model

Class Card

java.lang.Object
uno.v1.model.Card
public class Card extends Object
Represents a single UNO card with a color and a rank. Immutable value object.

    • isPlayable

      public boolean isPlayable(Card topCard, Color currentColor)
      Checks whether this card is playable on top of the given top card given the current active color. A card is playable if: - its color matches the current color, or - its rank matches the top card's rank, or - it is a wild card.
      Parameters:
      topCard - the current top card of the discard pile
      currentColor - the currently active color
      Returns:
      true if playable
